learner_operation: Identify which of four displayed numbers satisfy a scripted special set: intersect numerical class (integer/rational/real), sign, and zero inclusion.

fixed_features.feature: Four elementary real candidates and class/sign/zero membership
fixed_features.justification: Canonical e-13139 and all 11 supplied prompts require four independent classifications; tutorial 8215 defines scripted sets.

fixed_features.feature: Current code fixes response type to checkbox and targets to Q-, R0-, Z0-, Q0+, R0+
fixed_features.justification: This restriction is not justified by the original material: fully keyed radio sources q-80337 and q-104686 exist, and the former requires Q0-. Recorded as a failed coverage obligation, not endorsed as essential.

answer_roles.role: Target base class, sign and zero inclusion
answer_roles.eligible_variation: At least preserve original Q0-, Z0+, and radio Q0+ cases as well as existing targets; lesson permits same-method target changes.
answer_roles.observed: Five checkbox targets exercised; Q0- and Z0+ rejected explicitly; all radio families omitted.

answer_roles.role: Which candidate positions qualify and number of qualifying candidates
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any of four positions can qualify; zero through four ordinary members are meaningful.
answer_roles.observed: All 16 masks reproduced under each of five existing targets; None is selected precisely for mask zero.

answer_roles.role: Candidate sign, number class and superficial numeric magnitude
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change number class/sign to reconsider membership; preserve response for within-class magnitude changes.
answer_roles.observed: Q0+ -> R0+ adds sqrt2; 1/2 -> 3/4 under Q0+ preserves response. Actual rendered prompt/solution and native grader follow both changes.

coverage.case: Every existing target and membership mask
coverage.result: 80 controlled records: every mask 0..15 under each of five supported targets passed independent oracle and actual native true/false grading.
Three radio sources absent from replay. Fully keyed q-80337 Q0- and q-104686 Q0+ have no replay path; explicit Q0- target raises ValueError and Q0+ radio replay raises StopIteration.

All five survive. Profiles R0-, Q-, Q0+, R0+, Z0-; ordinary masks 12,4,12,4,11. Fixed first/last/none/all strategies do not solve the batch. Sign/zero reasoning suffices for all five; no claim that this small batch exercises class ambiguity.

counterfactuals.change: Hold [0, sqrt2, 1/2, -3] fixed, change target Q0+ to R0+ (counterfactual records 0 and 1).
counterfactuals.expected: sqrt2 changes from excluded to included; other three ordinary responses and None remain unchanged. Prompt and solution must follow target.
counterfactuals.observed: Truth vectors [true,false,true,false,false] -> [true,true,true,false,false]. Native grader accepts correct and rejects opposite on every field. Screenshots 001/002 visibly show target, changed sqrt2 selection and explanation/conclusion.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorial 8215 distinguishes rational versus real class under identical sign/zero scripts. Target identity is an eligible answer-bearing role.

counterfactuals.change: Under Q0+, hold other candidates fixed, replace positive noninteger rational 1/2 by 3/4 (counterfactual records 0 and 2).
counterfactuals.expected: Preserve all five truth values while updating displayed value and explanation/conclusion.
counterfactuals.observed: Both truth vectors [true,false,true,false,false]; actual native grader follows each field choice; screenshots 001/003 preserve selections and show updated fraction.
counterfactuals.justification: Magnitude within the positive rational noninteger class cannot affect Q0+ membership.

limitations: No live learner history, configured policy weights or future entity IDs were supplied. Inspected both configured positively weighted easy-band and unconfigured fallback rules; synthetic candidate ordering used for retained draws. Actual future selection probabilities under unknown policy/history are not claimed.
Captured inventory is fixed at basis 5456; later changes may alter deduplication. Publication preparation was absent.
No finite probe establishes the absence of all possible shortcuts. Sign/zero-only sufficiency in the exact batch is disclosed as limited class practice, not mislabeled an incidental surface cue.
Five non-source inventory records lack generation metadata; none demonstrated affected by the source-replay omissions. Original source radio questions were not treated as generated.
